ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white florets, cauliflower-like cluster of small rounded buds with slightly translucent edges and soft, moist surface, some flattened and clumped together, spread across the left-center of a white square plate, roughly 14 cm across, about 2-3 cm tall in places | 120
ITEM 2 | Orange carrot slices and rounds, bright orange with slightly darker edges, glossy and moist with a light sheen, some halved half-moons and some thicker rounds about 2-3 cm across, a few small pale flecks on the surfaces, clustered on the right side of the plate covering roughly a quarter of its area, piled 1-2 cm high | 110
